import requests, numpy as np, json
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
H={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0'}
B="""A R N D C Q E G H I L K M F P S T W Y V
A 4 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -1 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 0 -3 -2 0
R -1 5 0 -2 -3 1 0 -2 0 -3 -2 2 -1 -3 -2 -1 -1 -3 -2 -3

D -2 -2 1 6 -3 0 2 -1 -1 -3 -4 -1 -3 -3 -1 0 -1 -4 -3 -3
C 0 -3 -3 -3 9 -3 -4 -3 -3 -1 -1 -3 -1 -2 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1
Q -1 1 0 0 -3 5 2 -2 0 -3 -2 1 0 -3 -1 0 -1 -2 -1 -2

G 0 -2 0 -1 -3 -2 -2 6 -2 -4 -4 -2 -3 -3 -2 0 -2 -2 -3 -3
H -2 0 1 -1 -3 0 0 -2 8 -3 -3 -1 -2 -1 -2 -1 -2 -2 2 -3
I -1 -3 -3 -3 -1 -3 -3 -4 -3 4 2 -3 1 0 -3 -2 -1 -3 -1 3
L -1 -2 -3 -4 -1 -2 -3 -4 -3 2 4 -2 2 0 -3 -2 -1 -2 -1 1
K -1 2 0 -1 -3 1 1 -2 -1 -3 -2 5 -1 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2
M -1 -1 -2 -3 -1 0 -2 -3 -2 1 2 -1 5 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 1
F -2 -3 -3 -3 -2 -3 -3 -3 -1 0 0 -3 0 6 -4 -2 -2 1 3 -1
P -1 -2 -2 -1 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 -1 -2 -4 7 -1 -1 -4 -3 -2
S 1 -1 1 0 -1 0 0 0 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -2 -1 4 1 -3 -2 -2
T 0 -1 0 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 5 -2 -2 0
W -3 -3 -4 -4 -2 -2 -3 -2 -2 -3 -2 -3 -1 1 -4 -3 -2 11 2 -3
Y -2 -2 -2 -3 -2 -1 -2 -3 2 -1 -1 -2 -1 3 -3 -2 -2 2 7 -1
V 0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 3 1 -2 1 -1 -2 -2 0 -3 -1 4"""
L=B.strip().split("\n"); AA=L[0].split(); idx={a:i for i,a in enumerate(AA)}
MAT=np.full((21,21),-2.0)
for l in L[1:]:
    p=l.split()
    for c,v in zip(AA,p[1:]): MAT[idx[p[0]],idx[c]]=float(v)
def enc(s): return np.array([idx.get(c,20) for c in s])
def nw_lin(s1,s2,g=-8.0):
    e1,e2=enc(s1),enc(s2); n,m=len(s1),len(s2)
    Mm=np.zeros((n+1,m+1)); Mm[0,1:]=g*np.arange(1,m+1); Mm[1:,0]=g*np.arange(1,n+1)
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        s=MAT[e1[i-1],e2]                       # length m
        t=np.maximum(Mm[i-1,:-1]+s, Mm[i-1,1:]+g)
        j=np.arange(1,m+1)
        base=np.concatenate(([Mm[i,0]],t)) - g*np.arange(0,m+1)
        Mm[i,1:]=np.maximum.accumulate(base)[1:]+g*j
        Mm[i,1:]=np.maximum(Mm[i,1:], t)        # ensure t itself considered
        # redo properly: running max including left-gap extension
        row=np.empty(m+1); row[0]=Mm[i,0]
        best=row[0]
        for jj in range(1,m+1):
            v=max(t[jj-1], best+g); row[jj]=v; best=v
        Mm[i,:]=row
    # traceback
    i,j=n,m; A=[];C=[]
    while i>0 and j>0:
        s=MAT[e1[i-1],e2[j-1]]
        if abs(Mm[i,j]-(Mm[i-1,j-1]+s))<1e-9: A.append(s1[i-1]);C.append(s2[j-1]);i-=1;j-=1
        elif abs(Mm[i,j]-(Mm[i-1,j]+g))<1e-9: A.append(s1[i-1]);C.append('-');i-=1
        else: A.append('-');C.append(s2[j-1]);j-=1
    while i>0: A.append(s1[i-1]);C.append('-');i-=1
    while j>0: A.append('-');C.append(s2[j-1]);j-=1
    return ''.join(reversed(A)),''.join(reversed(C))

url=("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/stream?format=fasta&query="
     "%28gene%3AcdsA%29+AND+%28taxonomy_id%3A2%29+AND+%28reviewed%3Atrue%29")
txt=requests.get(url,headers=H,timeout=120).text
seqs={}
for blk in txt.split(">"):
    if not blk.strip(): continue
    lines=blk.split("\n"); hdr=lines[0]; s=''.join(lines[1:]).strip()
    acc=hdr.split("|")[1]; org=hdr.split("OS=")[1].split("OX=")[0].strip()
    if 200<len(s)<400: seqs[acc]=(org,s)
ec=seqs['P0ABG1'][1]
others={k:v for k,v in seqs.items() if k not in ('P0ABG1','P0ABG2','P0ABG3')}  # drop identical E.coli/Shigella dupes
print(f"E. coli query len {len(ec)}; scoring conservation across {len(others)} bacterial CdsA orthologs")

col = {r:[] for r in range(1,286)}
ident_overall=[]
for acc,(org,s) in others.items():
    a,b=nw_lin(ec,s)
    i=0; nid=0; nal=0
    for x,y in zip(a,b):
        if x!='-':
            i+=1
            if y!='-':
                col[i].append(y); nal+=1
                if x==y: nid+=1
    ident_overall.append((acc,org,100*nid/max(nal,1)))
cons={r: (sum(1 for y in col[r] if y==ec[r-1])/len(col[r]) if col[r] else np.nan) for r in range(1,286)}
import pandas as pd
ov=pd.DataFrame(ident_overall,columns=['acc','organism','pct_id']).sort_values('pct_id',ascending=False)
print("\nPairwise identity to E. coli CdsA (%):")
print(ov.to_string(index=False))

site=[(165,'D','Mg 2nd shell (Tm D144)'),(188,'K','near Mg (Tm K167)'),(231,'S','Tm D215 equiv (DIVERGENT)'),
      (235,'D','Mg/K dyad Asp (Tm D219)'),(238,'E','K+ ligand (Tm E222)'),(239,'S','K+ ligand (Tm S223)'),
      (242,'K','K+ ligand (Tm K226)'),(262,'D','Mg 2nd shell (Tm D246)'),(265,'D','Mg/K dyad Asp (Tm D249)'),
      (266,'S','Mg backbone N (Tm G250)')]
print(f"\n{'E.coli res':<12}{'role':<30}{'% orthologs identical':>22}{'n':>5}  variants")
rows=[]
for r,aa,role in site:
    v=col[r]; fr=100*cons[r]
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(v); var=', '.join(f"{k}:{n}" for k,n in cnt.most_common(4))
    print(f"{aa}{r:<11}{role:<30}{fr:>21.0f}%{len(v):>5}  {var}")
    rows.append(dict(ecoli=f"{aa}{r}",role=role,pct_identical=round(fr,1),n=len(v),variants=var))
pd.DataFrame(rows).to_csv('/tmp/cons.csv',index=False)

allc=np.array([cons[r] for r in range(1,286) if not np.isnan(cons[r])])
print(f"\nBackground: mean per-position identity across all 285 columns = {100*allc.mean():.1f}% (median {100*np.median(allc):.1f}%)")
sitev=np.array([cons[r] for r,_,_ in site])
from scipy import stats
u,p=stats.mannwhitneyu(sitev,allc,alternative='greater')
print(f"Mapped site positions (n={len(sitev)}) mean identity {100*sitev.mean():.1f}% vs background: Mann-Whitney U={u:.0f}, p={p:.2g}")
core4=[235,265,238,242]
print(f"Four direct metal-ligand positions (D235,D265,E238,K242): identity {100*np.mean([cons[r] for r in core4]):.0f}%")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(13,4.2))
rs=np.arange(1,286); cv=np.array([cons[r] if not np.isnan(cons[r]) else 0 for r in rs])
ax.bar(rs,100*cv,color='0.75',width=1.0)
for r,aa,role in site:
    ax.bar([r],[100*cons[r]],color='crimson',width=1.8)
    ax.annotate(f"{aa}{r}",(r,100*cons[r]),xytext=(0,4),textcoords='offset points',ha='center',fontsize=8,color='crimson')
ax.axhline(100*allc.mean(),color='royalblue',ls='--',lw=1.2,label=f'mean across all positions ({100*allc.mean():.0f}%)')
ax.set_xlabel('E. coli CdsA residue'); ax.set_ylabel('% of 36 bacterial CdsA orthologs\nwith the same residue')
ax.set_title('Conservation of the TmCdsA-derived metal-site positions in bacterial CdsA orthologs')
ax.legend(loc='upper left',fontsize=9); ax.set_xlim(0,286); ax.set_ylim(0,112)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
